info.title: Todos API
info.description: The todos of each user: made, changed, deleted, exported as CSV and followed live.

tags.name: Todos
tags.description: The todos of the signed-in user.

tags.name: Session
tags.description: Signing a browser in and out, with the cookie session.

get.description: A page of the todos that pass the filter of the query.

parameters.name: done
parameters.description: Only the todos that are done, or only those that are not; without it, both.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: How many todos a page holds.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Only the todos that have every one of these tags: ?tags=home&tags=shop, or ?tags=home,shop. The server changes the value before it checks it.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only the todos whose title holds these words, in any case. Leading and trailing spaces are removed. Converted to lowercase.

post.description: A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the todo it made.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Send the same key again to get the todo made the first time, not a second one. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.

200.description: The todo that the first request with this key made.

value.message: The plan allows no more todos

get.description: Server-sent events: each change of the user's todos, as it happens. A browser's EventSource sends the cookie session.

200.description: The events of the stream, each with the schema of its data: todo.created (TodoResponse), todo.updated (TodoResponse), todo.deleted (TodoIdPath).

post.description: Sets the cookie session to the token of the form and sends the browser to the page, /. A form that a page of another site posts gets 403.

303.description: Signed in: the cookie session is set, and the browser goes on to /.

delete.description: Clears the cookie session and ends the streams of live updates of the user.

CreateTodoRequest.description: A new todo of the signed-in user.

title.description: What to do. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.

dueDate.description: The day it is due. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.

tags.description: Labels of the todo, to find it by.

items.description: Leading and trailing spaces are removed. Converted to lowercase.

token.description: The token of the user. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.

TodoListResponse.description: A page of the todos of the signed-in user, in the order they were made.

perPage.description: How many todos a page holds.

total.description: How many todos pass the filter, on all the pages.

TodoResponse.description: A todo, as the API shows it.

dueDate.description: The day it is due; null for none.

tags.description: Labels of the todo, in lower case.

UpdateTodoRequest.description: What to change in a todo: a field that is not sent, or is null, stays as it is.

title.description: What to do. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.

dueDate.description: The day it is due. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.

bearer.description: The token of a user: Authorization: Bearer <token>.

session.description: The token of a user in the cookie session, which POST /api/session sets.
session.name: session
